How it works

From your first question to a tidy VAT position, in four steps.

01

Free consultation

You tell us what you do and what you expect to bill. We answer with numbers, not jargon.

02

Regime and ATECO code

We compare flat-rate, simplified and ordinary regimes on your real case and pick the most convenient.

03

04

Invoices, deadlines, F24 and your tax return: you always know how much to set aside and what is due, before the deadline hits.

Frequently asked questions

Is the flat-rate regime really worth it?

It depends on revenue, costs and activity type. The flat-rate regime applies a coefficient to turnover and does not deduct real costs, so with high expenses it may not be the best option. In the free consultation we compare it using your numbers.

Can I move to you with an existing VAT number?

Yes. We need your business details and your latest tax return, and we explain what to do with your current adviser and how the handover works.

What happens if I exceed 85,000 euro?

You leave the flat-rate regime the following year, or immediately above 100,000 euro. We warn you in advance and guide you into the simplified or ordinary regime.

Does the first consultation cost anything?

No, it is free and non-binding: it helps you understand whether and how to open a VAT number, which regime to pick and how much to set aside.
